incarnation: Kael Venn — current original project canon, Méridien Creux / Borrowed Hours DLC, selected individual atlas
visualLocks: Original Multiverse Breach character Kael Venn, Meridien Creux / Borrowed Hours. Current selected individual atlas plus exact ocDlcPacks visual text are internal identity authority after the documented V2 absence check.

Lean youthful source proportions, light warm tan skin, clean-shaven visible face, black spiky messy hair swept back with a few golden highlights. Exact age and iris colors undocumented: preserve source apparent age, no adult redesign.
Asymmetrical ROUND brass goggles over both eyes: wearer RIGHT lens (viewer LEFT in front view) is dark amber, wearer LEFT lens (viewer RIGHT) is pale cyan/ivory. No visor, extra lenses or hat.

High charcoal scarf, LONG charcoal-black courier coat with high flared gold lapels, brass clock shoulder disks, fine gold piping/clock accents and glowing amber lining/stolen-second specks. Long split irregular coat tails, never a short jacket.
Brown leather diagonal torso straps, square-buckled belt and pouches, charcoal pants with bronze/gold knee guards, dark laced mid-calf boots with gold/brown straps and dark fingerless gloves.
TWO narrow curved crescent minute blades: silver cutting edges, dark grips, circular brass clock guards/hilts. Gold arcs only as action VFX; no gun, staff or giant sword.
Exactly two human arms, two legs and boots; normal hands with five digits when readable. Complete coat tails, hair, weapon tips and boots inside canvas with positive margins.
Every theme family safe and nonromantic at unchanged source apparent age. Apron or WhatIf forms stay explicitly original, limited and fully clothed.
